quizzes.question_text: The point W(1,-3) is reflected over the x-axis. What are the coordinates of the resulting point, W' = (___, ___)
solution: Start with the point W(1,-3) and the x-axis.
Reflect the point over the line.
Since W is 3 units below the x-axis, W' is 3 units above the x-axis. W' has coordinates (1,3).
